title: Another hotel
content: I was in a hotel. It was the kind with multiple building units all located around an outdoor center, probably 30 floors to each building. It was 3 rectangular buildings forming a triangle around a garden or park area. The lobby was in the center building, such that the lobby was directly across from one of the points of the triangle. Inside, it was a lot of red and gold decor, the carpet looked like one of those wacky squiggly movie theater carpets but just shades of red and gold, not purple or blue or anything. The walls were a dark red, and doors were that kind of goldish metal seen in a lot of hotels. There was a front desk made of wood with red paneling, and a rack of brochures for, probably, local attractions. The exception was the elevator area, which looked like stainless steel. Potted plants, mostly tall fern type ones, were just everywhere. There were big windows to the outside allowing people to see the garden area. I tried to leave and couldn't, the doors wouldn't open, and someone approached me saying the hotel doubled as a containment zone for people who set fires. It was a teenage girl, said she was being held there for setting a building on fire. She told me that setting the hotel on fire wouldn't work to escape it, and we couldn't open any doors or windows. We eventually did escape by tricking a hotel guest into holding the door open for us.
